questions.question: What should be used to log and manage improvement opportunities?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A continual improvement register". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.92 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends that organizations should NOT start with a completely new design when improving a service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Start where you are". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.55 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which statement about the 'service level management' practice is CORRECT?

options.A: It should focus entirely on system-based technical metrics
options.B: It should set clear, business-based targets for service performance
options.C: It should be managed by a separate team with no customer contact
options.D: It should avoid the use of customer feedback surveys

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "It should set clear, business-based targets for service performance". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which role does a service consumer play when they define the requirements for a service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Customer". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which dimension of service management includes the relationships between different components of the service value system?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Value streams and processes". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.41 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: What is an output?

options.A: A result enabled by one or more outcomes
options.B: A tangible or intangible deliverable of an activity
options.C: A joint activity performed by providers and consumers
options.D: A configuration item managed by a supplier

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A tangible or intangible deliverable of an activity". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.26 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which is a recommendation of the 'collaborate and promote visibility' guiding principle?

options.A: Work in isolation to prevent external distractions
options.B: Ensure that all stakeholders have a shared understanding of goals
options.C: Avoid sharing information about improvement progress until complete
options.D: Focus only on relationships with internal stakeholders

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Ensure that all stakeholders have a shared understanding of goals". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.59 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is a core benefit of using a single continual improvement register?

options.A: It ensures that senior management authorizes every minor change
options.B: It allows improvement opportunities to be prioritized and managed effectively
options.C: It removes the need for individual teams to participate in improvement
options.D: It replaces the need for standard change enablement procedures

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "It allows improvement opportunities to be prioritized and managed effectively". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.92 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'deployment management' practice?

options.A: To make new services available for use
options.B: To move hardware, software, documentation, processes, or any other component to live environments
options.D: To plan and manage the full lifecycle of all IT assets

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To move hardware, software, documentation, processes, or any other component to live environments". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.195 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has a purpose that includes helping the organization to systematically observe services and service components?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Monitoring and event management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.138 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a purpose of the 'service desk' practice?

options.A: To set clear business-based targets for service levels
options.B: To capture demand for incident resolution and service requests
options.C: To manage risks to confidentiality, integrity and availability
options.D: To co-create value by designing new service offerings

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To capture demand for incident resolution and service requests". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.159 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the primary focus of the 'organizations and people' dimension?

options.A: Contracts and agreements with external suppliers
options.B: Roles, responsibilities, culture, and communication within teams
options.C: The workflow systems needed to deliver services
options.D: The databases and information security protocols

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Roles, responsibilities, culture, and communication within teams". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.35 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which statement about standard changes is CORRECT?

options.A: They are emergency changes that must be implemented immediately
options.B: They are pre-authorized, low-risk changes that follow a well-established procedure
options.C: They must be assessed and authorized by a full change advisory board
options.D: They are high-risk changes that require a custom business case

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "They are pre-authorized, low-risk changes that follow a well-established procedure". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is a workaround?

options.A: A permanent resolution to a known problem
options.B: A temporary solution that reduces or eliminates the impact of an active incident or problem
options.C: A type of standard change designed to bypass formal authorization
options.D: A process for escalating unresolved incidents to suppliers

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A temporary solution that reduces or eliminates the impact of an active incident or problem". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which value chain activity includes the categorization of incidents?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Deliver and support". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.75 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which is the first step of the continual improvement model?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "What is the vision?". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.77 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'supplier management' practice?

options.A: To move hardware and software components to live environments
options.B: To ensure that the organization's suppliers and their performance are managed appropriately
options.C: To set clear business-based targets for service levels
options.D: To co-create value through joint development

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To ensure that the organization's suppliers and their performance are managed appropriately". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.115 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has a purpose that includes ensuring that services continue to meet the needs of the organization?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service level management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends that an organization should understand how all the parts of an organization work together?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Think and work holistically". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.62 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is co-created through service relationships?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Value". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'service request management' practice?

options.A: To handle all agreed, user-initiated demands for service actions, access, information, or advice
options.B: To minimize the negative impact of service interruptions
options.C: To manage the lifecycle of all IT assets and hardware
options.D: To plan and execute normal and emergency changes

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "To handle all agreed, user-initiated demands for service actions, access, information, or advice". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which describes a standard change?

options.A: A change that must be implemented as soon as possible to resolve a major incident
options.B: A low-risk, pre-authorized change that is well-understood and has a standard procedure
options.C: A change that requires strategic authorization from a change advisory board
options.D: A change triggered automatically by a monitoring or event management tool

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A low-risk, pre-authorized change that is well-understood and has a standard procedure". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about known errors is CORRECT?

options.A: They are resolved automatically by self-help portals
options.B: They are problems that have been analyzed but remain unresolved
options.C: They are errors identified solely by external suppliers
options.D: They must be logged directly into the change schedule

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "They are problems that have been analyzed but remain unresolved". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the relationship between a service provider and a service consumer?

options.A: A contract that defines only the cost of service provision
options.B: A series of joint activities aimed at co-creating value based on service offerings
options.C: A relationship focused solely on the delivery of physical outputs
options.D: A formal SLA monitored by external regulators

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A series of joint activities aimed at co-creating value based on service offerings". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which dimension considers the workflows, controls, and procedures needed to achieve objectives?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Value streams and processes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.41 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends that an organization should first understand the current state before designing a new solution?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Start where you are". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.55 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'continual improvement' practice?

options.A: To handle all agreed user-initiated demands for service actions
options.B: To align the organization's practices and services with changing business needs
options.C: To establish and nurture the links between the organization and its stakeholders
options.D: To set clear targets for service level performance

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To align the organization's practices and services with changing business needs". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.117 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What describes the parameters of a service that must be met for the service to be fit for use?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Warranty". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.29 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which practice manages the lifecycle of all financially valuable components that can contribute to the delivery of an IT service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "IT asset management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.108 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about the 'incident management' practice is CORRECT?

options.A: Low-impact incidents should be logged on a weekly basis
options.B: All incidents must be fully resolved before a workaround is documented
options.C: Low-impact incidents should be resolved efficiently to minimize resource usage
options.D: Incidents with the lowest business impact should be prioritized first

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Low-impact incidents should be resolved efficiently to minimize resource usage". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.131 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice recommends using a collaborative technique called swarming?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Incident management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.132 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the primary benefit of standardizing and automating service requests?

options.A: It eliminates the need for any approval procedures
options.B: It streamlines the fulfilment workflow and reduces manual errors
options.C: It removes the need for customer satisfaction metrics
options.D: It automatically converts requests into emergency changes

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "It streamlines the fulfilment workflow and reduces manual errors". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which dimension considers the communication and collaboration tools used by teams?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Information and technology". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.36 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which guiding principle is most concerned with end-to-end service delivery?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Think and work holistically". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.62 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the definition of an outcome?

options.A: A tangible or intangible deliverable of an activity
options.B: A result for a stakeholder enabled by one or more outputs
options.C: Any financially valuable component contributing to service delivery
options.D: A joint activity performed by providers and consumers

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A result for a stakeholder enabled by one or more outputs". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.26 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'relationship management' practice?

options.A: To observe and systematically record configuration changes
options.B: To identify, analyze, monitor, and continually improve links with stakeholders
options.C: To handle user-initiated requests for service actions
options.D: To move software and components to live environments

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To identify, analyze, monitor, and continually improve links with stakeholders". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.106 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which change type requires rapid authorization, typically by an expedited process?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Emergency change". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'service configuration management' practice?

options.A: To set clear business-based targets for service level metrics
options.B: To ensure that accurate and reliable information about the configuration of services is available
options.C: To protect the confidentiality and integrity of all IT assets
options.D: To systematically observe services and resolve operational errors

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To ensure that accurate and reliable information about the configuration of services is available". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.204 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which step of the continual improvement model answers the question 'Where do we want to be?'?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Define measurable targets". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.77 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'release management' practice?

options.A: To move hardware and software components to live environments
options.B: To make new and changed services and features available for use
options.D: To plan and execute normal change enablement procedures

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To make new and changed services and features available for use". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.144 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice involves managing the links between an organization and its stakeholders?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Relationship management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.106 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about the 'service desk' practice is CORRECT?

options.A: It should focus purely on resolving complex technical bugs
options.B: It should provide a single point of contact for all service users
options.C: It must avoid the use of automation or self-help channels
options.D: It should operate from a single, centralized physical office

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "It should provide a single point of contact for all service users". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.159 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'monitoring and event management' practice?

options.A: To handle pre-defined, user-initiated demands for service actions
options.B: To systematically observe services and service components
options.C: To minimize the negative impact of active service interruptions
options.D: To co-create value by resolving known system issues

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To systematically observe services and service components". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.138 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which dimension is concerned with the contracts and agreements between the service provider and third parties?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Partners and suppliers". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.40 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which guiding principle emphasizes that services should not be designed to handle every possible exception?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Keep it simple and practical". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.63 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the definition of utility?

options.A: The functionality offered by a product or service to meet a particular need
options.B: The assurance that a product or service will meet availability requirements
options.C: A measure of the total cost incurred in service consumption
options.D: A joint activity aimed at co-creating value for users

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "The functionality offered by a product or service to meet a particular need". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.29 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: What is a key activity of problem management?

options.A: Restoring normal service operations as quickly as possible
options.B: Identifying actual and potential causes of incidents
options.C: Handling user-initiated requests for physical assets

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Identifying actual and potential causes of incidents". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which role is responsible for authorizing the budget for service consumption?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Sponsor". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: What is the purpose of a continual improvement register (CIR)?

options.A: To log and prioritize all change enablement requests
options.B: To track, prioritize, and manage improvement opportunities
options.C: To log active incidents and their temporary workarounds
options.D: To record the performance metrics of external suppliers

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To track, prioritize, and manage improvement opportunities". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.92 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about emergency changes is CORRECT?

options.A: They do not require any formal assessment or authorization
options.B: They follow a streamlined authorization process to enable rapid implementation
options.C: They are typically implemented as pre-authorized standard changes
options.D: They must be postponed until a full change advisory board meeting is scheduled

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "They follow a streamlined authorization process to enable rapid implementation". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice is responsible for moving new software to a production environment?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Deployment management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.195 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a key activity of service request management?

options.A: Restoring normal service after a major hardware crash
options.B: Handling requests for password resets or laptop provisioning
options.C: Identifying root causes of multiple recurring network bugs
options.D: Authorizing normal changes in the production database

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Handling requests for password resets or laptop provisioning". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What describes the joint activities performed by a service provider and a service consumer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service relationship management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends using measurements to support direct observation, rather than replacing it?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Start where you are". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.56 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the definition of a problem?

options.A: An unplanned interruption or reduction in the quality of service
options.B: A cause, or potential cause, of one or more incidents
options.C: Any component that needs to be managed to deliver a service
options.D: A change of state that has significance for service management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A cause, or potential cause, of one or more incidents". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.203 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice provides a single point of contact for all users?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service desk". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.159 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which dimension includes the skills, competencies, roles, and responsibilities of the staff?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Organizations and people". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.35 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends that an organization should seek feedback at every stage of an improvement initiative?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Progress iteratively with feedback". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.57 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is a change schedule used for?

options.A: To record user-initiated demands for service
options.B: To help plan, schedule, and avoid conflicts when implementing changes
options.C: To track the performance metrics of support staff
options.D: To register known bugs that require workarounds

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To help plan, schedule, and avoid conflicts when implementing changes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.130 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has the purpose of setting clear, business-based targets for service levels?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service level management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What are the four dimensions of service management?

options.A: Organizations and people, Information and technology, Partners and suppliers, Value streams and processes
options.B: Plan, Improve, Engage, Deliver and support

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Organizations and people, Information and technology, Partners and suppliers, Value streams and processes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.33 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

questions.question: Which statement about the service value chain is CORRECT?

options.A: It converts value into customer requirements
options.B: Each activity uses different combinations of practices to convert inputs into outputs
options.C: It is managed strictly by senior executive officers with no input from suppliers
options.D: It replaces the need for the four dimensions of service management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Each activity uses different combinations of practices to convert inputs into outputs". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.68 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which practice manages vulnerabilities that were not resolved before the service went live?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Problem management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the relationship between utility and warranty?

options.C: Warranty is defined by the sponsor, while utility is defined by the user

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Utility is fitness for purpose, while warranty is fitness for use". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.29 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

questions.question: Which practice handles user-initiated requests for information, advice, or access?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service request management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a type of change in ITIL v4?

questions.question: What is the definition of a configuration item (CI)?

options.B: Any component that needs to be managed in order to deliver an IT service
options.C: A problem logged by a system administrator
options.D: An output provided directly to a customer

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Any component that needs to be managed in order to deliver an IT service". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.194 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which guiding principle promotes the use of Lean, Agile, and DevOps methods?

questions.question: What is a workaround used for?

options.D: To document feedback from regular customer service reviews

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To temporarily reduce or eliminate the negative impact of an incident or problem". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which value chain activity ensures that services are delivered according to agreed specifications?

questions.question: Which role is played by an organization that defines the requirements for a service?

questions.question: What is the purpose of the service value system (SVS)?

options.A: To ensure that the organization continually co-creates value with all stakeholders through the use and management of products and services
options.B: To set up a central repository for logging all system errors and service requests
options.C: To manage the formal contracts and SLAs between providers and sponsors

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "To ensure that the organization continually co-creates value with all stakeholders through the use and management of products and services". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.47 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which dimension of service management considers the security and compliance requirements of an organization's partners?

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends focusing on the end-to-end customer journey?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Focus on value". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.49 (CHAPTER 4).

options.B: A change authority should be assigned to each type of change and change model
options.C: Change authorities are only required for emergency changes

options.A: Skills, competencies, and communication among personnel
options.B: Workflows, activities, controls, and procedures needed to achieve objectives
options.C: The hardware, databases, and application security parameters
options.D: Contracts and formal relationships with third-party suppliers

questions.question: Which step of the continual improvement model involves executing the improvement plan?
